substrates.meaning: bytes32 values typed in the most significant byte by ExternalStateSubstrateLib: ASSET (1, address allowed for enter/exit accounting), TARGET (2, address in the low 160 bits plus a bytes4 selector at bits 160..191 — one allowed external call), CUSTODIAN (3, address allowed to propose/confirm balance updates on the executor), BALANCE_ACCOUNT (4, address bucket), STALENESS_MAX (5, uint248 seconds), BIG_CHANGE_BPS (6, uint248 basis points), DUST_THRESHOLD (7, uint248 percent), MIN_UPDATE_INTERVAL (8, uint248 seconds). The operation fuse checks ASSET and BALANCE_ACCOUNT when amount > 0 and every action's TARGET+selector; the executor reads the scalar and CUSTODIAN entries. TARGET grants must never overlap ASSET addresses (the fuse does not police it).

valuation.pricedAssets: the executor's tracked total balance, already expressed in the vault's underlying asset (sum of balance accounts as credited on enter and updated by custodian confirmations), priced as the underlying; tokens physically held by the executor are not read. balanceOf() is not a view: it stores the last total and custodian timestamp and sets the vault-scoped pause flag when a custodian update moves the total by more than BIG_CHANGE_BPS
valuation.priceSource: PlasmaVaultLib.getPriceOracleMiddleware, i.e. the PriceOracleMiddleware the vault points at, getAssetPrice for the underlying (and for the transferred asset on enter/exit)

substrates.meaning: bytes32 values typed in the most significant byte by AsyncActionFuseLib: ALLOWED_AMOUNT_TO_OUTSIDE (0: address in the upper 160 bits of the 31-byte payload, uint88 max amount in the lower 88 bits — one token the vault may send to its executor and the cap per enter), ALLOWED_TARGETS (1: target address and bytes4 selector — one external call the executor may make), ALLOWED_EXIT_SLIPPAGE (2: uint248 slippage tolerance applied by AsyncExecutor.fetchAssets). The action fuse decodes the whole list on enter and exit; the balance fuse does not read substrates.
substrates.checkFunction: AsyncActionFuseLib.decodeAsyncActionFuseSubstrates over PlasmaVaultConfigLib.getMarketSubstrates, then in-fuse matching of token/amount and target/selector
